paper.title_en: Primordial black holes as a natural consequence of scale-invariance
paper.abstract_en: We show that a scale-invariant $U(1)$ gauge theory can naturally realize large curvature perturbations around the end of thermal inflation, seeding the formation of primordial black holes (PBHs). The allowed nonminimal gravitational interaction $ξ$ of the Higgs field induces a Hubble-scale negative mass-squared term for positive $ξ\sim \mathcal{O}(1)$, and triggers a second order phase transition that ends thermal inflation while keeping the extra $e$-folds small. This sharp contrast to the minimally coupled case allows the gauge coupling to be much smaller than unity. It turns out that field fluctuations are dominated by thermal fluctuations around the onset of the phase transition, and sufficiently amplified to produce an appreciable amount of PBHs with a wide range of possible masses. The associated scalar-induced gravitational waves (GWs) are accompanied by cosmic-string induced GWs coming from the breaking of the $U(1)$ symmetry. As a result, the generated PBH population can have a correlated GW signature relevant to pulsar timing arrays, space-based interferometers, or ground-based detectors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将尺度不变U(1)规范理论与热暴胀末期的相变机制结合，自然产生原初黑洞，并给出与脉冲星计时阵列、空间/地面干涉仪相关的标量诱导引力波与宇宙弦引力波关联信号，与PTA主题直接相关；理论构造清晰、机制具体，但缺少数值细节与可检验的定量预言，故给予中等偏上的评分。
decision.title_zh: 原初黑洞作为尺度不变性的自然结果
decision.abstract_zh: 我们表明，一个尺度不变的 $U(1)$ 规范理论可以在热暴胀末期自然实现大的曲率扰动，从而为原初黑洞（PBHs）的形成提供种子。希格斯场允许的非最小引力相互作用 $ξ$ 在正 $ξ\sim \mathcal{O}(1)$ 时诱导出哈勃尺度的负质量平方项，并触发一个二阶相变，该相变终结热暴胀，同时使额外的 $e$-fold 数保持很小。这与最小耦合情形的鲜明对比，使得规范耦合可以远小于 1。结果表明，场涨落由相变开始附近的热涨落主导，并被充分放大，从而产生可观数量的、具有广泛可能质量范围的原初黑洞。相关的标量诱导引力波（GWs）伴随着来自 $U(1)$ 对称性破缺的宇宙弦诱导引力波。因此，所产生的原初黑洞族群可以具有与脉冲星计时阵列、空间基干涉仪或地面探测器相关的关联引力波特征。
